requirement: SOC 0–1/0–100 conversion documented; three SOC types kept separate
0–100 is table domain; 5–95 is priority test window, not certified validity
note: Below 5 and above 95 evaluated separately; no invisible clamp

requirement: Record voltage RMSE/bias, SOC endpoint error, current and DC energy on holdout
note: Suggested research targets: voltage RMSE <=2V, absolute bias <=1V, SOC error <=2pp, DC energy error <=5%; agree before runs

requirement: 0–8250rpm, torque limit curve, abs shaft <=150kW; no out-of-grid extrapolation
Bilinear loss kW at motor-equivalent rpm/Nm; log stencil support
note: Do not interpolate percent efficiency at zero speed/torque

requirement: Same native ANL phase, test mass/roadload/aux/temp/initial energy; speed error and DC energy
note: EDU source MY2018 vs ANL MY2017 is a transfer assumption

requirement: Integrate nonnegative g/s to kg; map speed/torque bounds and fuel definition match
note: Density needed for liters; LHV needed only for thermal energy

requirement: Same cycle/hardware/aux/temp; initial and terminal stored energy matched
note: Initial and terminal tolerance default 0.1kWh is adjustable research setting; no invented fuel correction

requirement: Start, idle, warmup, shutdown/restart states accounted or explicitly steady-state-only
note: Steady fuel map alone does not support actual total fuel claim

requirement: Declared battery and fuel inventories, SOC/voltage/fuel stop, speed feasibility, repeated mission
note: Fixed-cycle distance is not depletion range

requirement: Battery DC vs wall AC and test/adjustment procedure distinguished
note: No automatic 0.7 tuning to match advertised range
